    • findOverlappingLanes

      @Query(value="SELECT DISTINCT l.* FROM reservation_lanes rl JOIN reservations r ON rl.reservation_id = r.id JOIN lanes l ON rl.lane_id = l.id WHERE r.reservation_date = :date AND r.status NOT IN (\'CANCELLED\', \'REJECTED\', \'NO_SHOW\') AND r.reservation_time_utc < :endTime AND DATE_ADD(r.reservation_time_utc, INTERVAL r.duration_hours HOUR) > :startTime", nativeQuery=true) List<Lane> findOverlappingLanes(@Param("date") LocalDate date, @Param("startTime") LocalDateTime startTime, @Param("endTime") LocalDateTime endTime)
